segments.ja: ウトガルドの朝は、現在の負傷だけでは終わりません。終わらない部分が、訓練兵だったころのユミルとクリスタへ戻ります。戻る記憶は、説明のための回想ではなく、二人がなぜ塔の上でその名前を使ったかの根拠です。根拠は、優しい物語だけではありません。名前を奪われ、名前を与えられた、二人の別々の過去が重なります。重なりが、ヒストリアという短い音を必要にします。必要は、今日やっと表に出ます。
segments.en: The morning at Utgard does not end with the present wounds alone. The part that does not end goes back to Ymir and Christa when they were trainees. The memory that returns is not a recollection for decoration. It is the ground for why those two used that name on the tower. The ground is not only a kind story. Two separate pasts, one of a stolen name and one of a given name, overlap. The overlap needs the short sound Historia. The need finally comes to the surface today.

segments.titleEn: A person who had no name
segments.ja: ユミルは、自分の名が信仰の道具だった時代を知っています。知っている名は、本人の人生ではなく、周囲が拝むための看板でした。看板が落ちたあと、彼女は巨人として長い時間を過ごし、人の形に戻ったときには何も持っていません。持っていない状態を、彼女は不幸の自慢にはしません。しない代わりに、同じ看板を他の誰かには被せないと決めます。決めた相手が、クリスタです。クリスタは、その時点ではまだ役の名前です。
segments.en: Ymir knows a time when her own name was a tool of faith. The name she knows was not her own life. It was a sign for the people around her to worship. After the sign fell, she spent a long time as a Titan, and when she returned to a human shape she had nothing. She does not make that having-nothing into a boast of misfortune. Instead she decides she will not put the same sign on anyone else. The person she decides this for is Christa. At that point Christa is still the name of a role.

segments.ja: 人に戻ったユミルの近くには、壁の外で遭難した仲間の記憶があります。三人で歩き、一人が彼女を生かす選択をした、という断片です。断片は、完全な物語にはなりません。ならないまま、彼女の中で戦士という言葉の前史になります。前史を、訓練兵団の誰にも話しません。話さない過去が、彼女の皮肉の下に残ります。皮肉は、本当の孤独を隠す蓋です。蓋の相手にだけ、彼女は蓋を外しかけます。
segments.en: Near the Ymir who became human again, there is a memory of companions who were stranded outside the walls. A fragment: three people walking, and one of them choosing to let her live. The fragment does not become a complete story. Even so, it becomes the prehistory of the word warrior inside her. She tells that prehistory to no one in the Training Corps. The untold past stays under her sarcasm. Sarcasm is a lid that hides a real loneliness. Only toward one person does she start to take the lid off.

segments.ja: クリスタは、良い新兵として作られています。作られた良さは、周囲が安心するための役です。役を演じる彼女は、自分の本名を訓練の外に置きました。置いた本名がヒストリアです。ヒストリアで生きると、壁の内の誰かの都合が壊れます。壊れることを恐れて、彼女はクリスタの笑顔を完璧にします。完璧な笑顔を、ユミルは一番最初に偽物だと見ます。見る目は、侮辱ではなく、救出です。
segments.en: Christa has been made as a good recruit. The goodness she was made with is a role so that the people around her can feel safe. Playing the role, she set her real name outside the training. The real name she set aside is Historia. If she lives as Historia, someone's convenience inside the walls breaks. Fearing the break, she perfects Christa's smile. Ymir is the first to see that the perfect smile is a fake. The eyes that see it are not an insult. They are a rescue.

segments.en: At a base in the interior, Christa keeps the arrangement in which people like her. The arrangement she keeps is safe. Inside the safety, only Ymir stands on the side that knows her real name. Standing there is not possession. It is a trust close to complicity. The other trainees see the trust as mere partiality. Even being seen that way, the two of them add no explanation. The silence that adds nothing becomes the ground that can produce a name later, on the tower. At this point the ground is still between love and duty.

segments.ja: 同じ訓練の端に、エレンとライナーがいます。二人は、ユミルとクリスタの過去を知りません。知らないまま、それぞれの正しさで新兵の列を作ります。列の中で、ユミルはエレンの直進とライナーの面倒見を、別種の看板として観察します。観察は、仲間を敵と呼ぶためではありません。看板が人を殺す現場を、彼女はすでに知っているからです。知っている目が、後の壁の上の告白を先に理解します。理解は、今日はまだ未来です。
segments.en: At the edge of the same training are Eren and Reiner. The two of them do not know Ymir and Christa's past. Not knowing it, they build the recruit column each with his own correctness. Inside the column, Ymir watches Eren's straight path and Reiner's caretaking as different kinds of signs. The watching is not in order to call comrades enemies. It is because she already knows scenes where a sign kills a person. The eyes that know will understand, ahead of time, the confession later on the wall. The understanding is still the future today.

segments.titleJa: 自分の人生と言い切る
segments.ja: ユミルがクリスタに繰り返す核は、自分の人生を生きろ、ということです。核は標語としては簡単で、実行は壁の政治に触れます。触れることを、ユミルは恐れてやめません。やめない理由は、自分が看板として消費された痛みです。痛みを、彼女はクリスタに移植しようとはしません。しない代わりに、その痛みの再演を拒みます。拒む言葉は荒いです。荒い言葉の宛先は、いつも一人です。
segments.en: The core Ymir repeats to Christa is to live her own life. As a slogan the core is simple, and the carrying-out touches the politics of the walls. Ymir does not stop because she is afraid of the touch. The reason she does not stop is the pain of having been used up as a sign. She does not try to transplant that pain into Christa. Instead she refuses a repeat performance of the pain. The refusing words are rough. The address of the rough words is always one person.

segments.en: The moment Christa steps down from the role is not a dramatic ceremony. It is a small refusal: not answering someone's expectation with a smile. After the refusal, perfection falls off her face. Ymir sees the fallen face, for the first time, as her face. She calls the seeing by the name Historia. The way of calling does not yet ride on a public roster. They use the name that does not ride there only between the two of them. Using it is the real graduation of the training years.
